name: Menu Item Group Role Access
description: Controls MENU ITEM visibility by group and role, with an option to ignore (overwrite) the menu target's access check. This governs whether the LINK shows, not access to the target — target access is unchanged, so hiding/showing a menu item is not a security boundary; the 'overwrite target access' option can disclose links/titles of content the user still can't open.
project_description:
Why would you need this module? 
 Sometimes, we need to display menu links based on user group roles. In such cases, this module proves helpful in preventing access to menu items based on group roles.

 What Menu Item Role Access Does 
 This module introduces an optional role field to menu items, listing all available group roles. A user with the ability to edit menu items can then select the roles that have access to view this menu item.
